title: Rabbi Shmuel ben Elazar
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Shabbat, chapter 14, at the end of halakhah 3, saying, “Rabbi Meir used to permit.” This is a scribal error: it should read Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar, as in the Babylonian Talmud there, 134a, and in Berakhot 1:1.[^1][^2]

notes.text: סה״ג means the end of halakhah 3. The proposed Shmuel/Shimon correction is Hyman’s.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat passage reads Shmuel ben Elazar, while the checked Babylonian Shabbat and Jerusalem Berakhot parallels read Shimon ben Elazar. Hyman’s statement that Shimon should be read is retained as his correction; the supplied Hebrew and its Shmuel heading remain unchanged.
